behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert number/operator/eof spans across original whitespace and leading zeroes.
Assert precedence, associativity and exact lexical/parser failure positions.
docDelivery: Document public token shape, UTF16 span convention and limited grammar.
Explain eager lexical errors before parsing and unchanged evaluator.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Bounded integer expression language with eager lexical validation, exact errors and original UTF16 spans.
manualBehavior: Evaluator uses exported lexer rather than retaining duplicate tokenization; no dynamic execution of source.
independence: Separate expression lexing from evaluation while preserving precedence, token spans and exact syntax failures.
